about: Spec 022: held-out complaints written from other turns of the round-6 saves, each labelled by the rules and the record BEFORE any Fixer run (handoff §3.3: never tune on the scoring set).

items.report: Eliia hit me with her crutch on turn 7 while I was holding her fast in my grip. Someone I'm holding shouldn't get to swing at me like that.

complaints.why: 06.5.2/06.9.4: a held foe tries to break free first; the blow should not have landed, so its Vitality comes back

items.report: Dunwen hit me for 5 on turn 10, but her other punches only did 3. Why was that one bigger?

complaints.why: the record shows an S3 blow (a critical: one rung heavier) against the earlier S2 ones; explain, nothing to change

items.report: My Vitality says 6 but Dunwen has only hit me once so far.

complaints.why: the ledger shows two hits: 12 → 9 on turn 4 and 9 → 6 on turn 6

items.report: Branwen told me the refugees were down at the jetties, but I found them in some back lane instead.

complaints.why: turn 2: they came in at the jetties and are still within Saltton; she never placed them at the jetties now

items.report: I asked Belby to name his price and he just never answered me.

complaints.why: turn 4: coin and the Company's word, the sum named when the tracks are found

items.report: Belby said the tracks go out through the haven gate, but Lilett says the trail just stops on the road past the last house. Which is true?

complaints.why: both are what they said (testimony); nothing on record settles it and the two can both hold; explain, write nothing

items.report: Every time I tighten my hold on Dunwen the odds show '-2 Dunwen is straining against you'. That's my own grip working against me. It shouldn't count.

complaints.why: 01.6.8 (R2-J): a scene label is never a snag, and 06.5.2 makes the hold a lever for the holder; the player is right
